name: kollymd
description: Local Obsidian-like knowledge base built on Electron + TypeScript

scripts.postinstall: node node_modules/electron/install.js && xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app 2>/dev/null; codesign --force --deep --sign - node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html
